## Why visit

A brewery experience with a clear cask component, making it a useful modern complement to the traditional-pub days. The taproom sits close to the production equipment and offers a broad view of Track’s current brewing. A cask Sonoma, if available, is a particularly useful comparison with the brewery’s keg range. Pizza makes this an easy food anchor for the Piccadilly brewery cluster, and the proximity to Cloudwater allows a coherent tasting afternoon without excessive travel between stops.

## Beer

Official site advertises three cask and twenty keg lines, mainly Track with occasional guests; CAMRA lists Sonoma as regular cask.

Slice Culture pizza on selected days, currently Wednesday–Sunday on the operator’s page; verify your specific date.

## Plan the visit

The official website and CAMRA differ on Monday opening and Sunday closing; use the operator’s current information and confirm directly if those days matter. Card only according to CAMRA.

**Getting there:** Walk from Manchester Piccadilly or New Islington; close to Cloudwater Unit 9.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
